text:
alex_g: Quick alignment — planning kernel v2.8 + 'slim-2' quant profile rollout this weekend. Target window: Sat 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need: EU canary owner, smoke checklist runner, rollback watcher, and a short preflight Fri 22:30 UTC. Who can take which?

maria_k: I can own the EU canary. I will claim the slice and run the canary harness. Can do preflight Fri 22:30 UTC.

kevin_l: I'll take rollback watcher and SLO/alert monitoring for the window. Will set thresholds and be on-call.

 tina_r: I'll run perf + KV-cache sanity and endpoint smoke (latency, mem, top). I'll also validate hallucination/quality on a small prompt set. Pinging eng-ml for a quick eval vector. PR: #456.

alex_g: Thanks — maria, tina, kevin. Notes for canary: use slim-2 config with '--prefill-kv=true' and keep batch size at 8. If p50 > 300ms switch to cpu-quantized fallback. Commands below.

alex_g: ```bash
# claim slice
claim_slice --env=prod --slice=eu-canary --duration=2h --owner=maria_k

# start canary runner
canary-runner --model=kernel-v2.8 --quant=slim-2 --batch=8 --prefill-kv=true

# rollback (example)
deploy-rollback --to-tag=kernel-v2.7 --force --reason='regression or latency spike'
```

maria_k: Claimed slice: https://infra/claim/1234. I'll drop a concise runbook in the slice channel and post a 15m-before-start check-in.

kevin_l: I'll attach dashboards: /dashboards/runtime-slo and set alerts: latency p50>250ms, error_rate>0.5%. Will post alert links here before window.

deploy-bot: Created ticket #DPL-7890 for weekend rollout. Assignees: maria_k, kevin_l, tina_r. ETA created.

tina_r: Quick QA note — recommended prompt set: ["summary_small", "qa_factual", "fewshot_style"]. I'll paste full prompts into the runbook and record baseline outputs.

alex_g: CR ping — PR #456 (runtime: quant profile slim-2) needs final LGTM from eng-runtime by EOD Fri. @kevin_l @maria_k can you review? If blocker found during preflight, call rollback.

maria_k: Reviewing now. Left a small comment about conf load ordering.

kevin_l: LGTM on rollback hooks; one minor telemetry tag nit that I'll fix post-rollout if unrelated.

alex_g: Final cadence: preflight Fri 22:30 (maria/tina), slot claim Sat 01:45, canary start 02:00-03:00, evaluate 03:00-03:30, ramp 03:30-04:00. Abort/rb criteria: p50 > 350ms, error rate > 1%, or quality regression above threshold -> immediate rollback. Otherwise proceed. I'll be on call and monitoring.

tina_r: Noted. I'll post smoke results here as short messages (latency, mem, example outputs). :white_check_mark:

maria_k: All set — see you in the slot. :rocket:
